title: Topic editor Cancel drops an in-flight create/save, so its answer and refusal are never shown
trigger: Manage topics > New Topic, type a name, press Create (editor.submit = Sending), then press Cancel (not disabled while sending)
effect: cancel_topic_editor sets dialog.editor = None; settle_topic_editor then returns early, so a refused create/edit shows no error, and forum_editor_sending() is false so a second New Topic can send a duplicate
fix: Disable Cancel while editor.submit is Sending (as the welcome editor does), or keep the Sending stage in a separate pending list the dialog settles after the editor closes

title: HistoryFocus::Away/Focused mirrors the history's FocusHandle focus; only ArmedForFirst is ever read
trigger: Focus enters or leaves the history; on_focus_in is deferred a frame and on_focus_out sets Away
effect: No bug today: outside tests nothing reads Away vs Focused (is_focused is cfg(test)), so the enum is an Option<ChatId> with two dead variants kept in step with GPUI focus by hand
fix: Replace with Option<ChatId> (armed-for-first chat) and read focus from FocusHandle::is_focused

title: Release timer re-arms every 2 s while a clip with sound sits off screen
trigger: Click a round video so it plays with sound, pause it (Audio::Sounding{paused:true}) or let it play, scroll its row into the list overdraw so it stays in the window's pass
effect: sweep() skips Release for audio.has_sound(), the slot stays OffScreen so hidden stays true and arm_release schedules another Sweep::Timer every RELEASE_AFTER for as long as the slot lives: a 2 s wake-up loop for no work
fix: Arm the release timer only when a slot can actually be released (off screen and Audio::Muted); re-arm from the audio transition back to Muted
